info.title: Conflict Economic Impact Simulator
info.description: Local-projection estimates of how armed conflict is associated with GDP per capita, FDI and poverty, plus a Monte Carlo scenario simulator. Estimates are associational, not causal.

get.description: Generated findings for the scrolling page (python -m conflict_sim.findings).
Real past wars as reference scenarios, with intensity measured from the data.
